tool.name: RADAR-PD Diagnostic: Facility Access
tool.description: report read-only SNS/HFIR path visibility and permissions
tool.command:
touch '$report' '$console_output' && trap "chmod a+r '$report' '$console_output' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT && set -euo pipefail && python - '$facility_root' '$instrument' '$ipts' '$relative_path' '$report' <<'PY' > '$console_output' 2>&1 import json import os import re import sys from pathlib import Path
facility_root, instrument_raw, ipts_raw, relative_raw, report_path = sys.argv[1:] if facility_root not in {"/SNS", "/HFIR"}: raise SystemExit("Facility root must be /SNS or /HFIR")
instrument = instrument_raw.strip().upper() if not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Z0-9_-]+", instrument): raise SystemExit("Invalid instrument name")
match = re.fullmatch(r"IPTS[-_ ]?(\d+)", ipts_raw.strip(), re.IGNORECASE) if not match: raise SystemExit("IPTS must look like IPTS-12345") ipts = f"IPTS-{match.group(1)}"
relative = Path(relative_raw.strip() or ".") if relative.is_absolute() or ".." in relative.parts: raise SystemExit("Relative path must remain inside the selected IPTS")
base = (Path(facility_root) / instrument / ipts).resolve(strict=False) target = (base / relative).resolve(strict=False) try: target.relative_to(base) except ValueError: raise SystemExit("Resolved path escapes the selected IPTS")
result = { "facility_root": facility_root, "instrument": instrument, "ipts": ipts, "base": str(base), "relative_path": str(relative), "target": str(target), "exists": target.exists(), "is_directory": target.is_dir(), "is_file": target.is_file(), "readable": os.access(target, os.R_OK), "writable": os.access(target, os.W_OK), "searchable": os.access(target, os.X_OK), "entries": [], "read_probe": None, }
if target.is_dir(): try: entries = [] with os.scandir(target) as scan: for entry in scan: try: kind = "directory" if entry.is_dir(follow_symlinks=False) else "file" size = entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False).st_size if kind == "file" else None except OSError as exc: kind = "unavailable" size = None entries.append({"name": entry.name, "kind": kind, "size": size, "error": str(exc)}) continue entries.append({"name": entry.name, "kind": kind, "size": size}) result["entries"] = sorted(entries, key=lambda item: item["name"].lower())[:100] result["list_probe"] = "ok" except OSError as exc: result["list_probe"] = f"error: {exc}" elif target.is_file(): try: with target.open("rb") as handle: sample = handle.read(64) result["read_probe"] = {"status": "ok", "bytes_read": len(sample), "size": target.stat().st_size} except OSError as exc: result["read_probe"] = {"status": "error", "message": str(exc)}
Path(report_path).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8") print(json.dumps(result, indent=2)) PY

param.name: relative_path
param.label: Path inside the IPTS
param.help: Leave empty to inspect the IPTS root. Absolute paths and parent traversal are rejected.

tool.help: This prototype diagnostic is read-only. It reports whether an SNS or HFIR path exists in the NDIP batch container, whether a directory can be listed, whether a file can be opened, and the effective read/write/search permission flags. It never creates, changes, or deletes facility data.
